name: morpho-risk-monitor
description: Onchain risk forensics: two widely quoted numbers measured against the chain, and what the gap means for vault allocation. Code, data, preregistrations, and every rejected approach.

paragraphs: Two numbers the ecosystem quotes, measured against the chain. Both came out smaller than the headline — by 589x in one case and by roughly three orders of magnitude in the other. Code, data, preregistrations and every rejected approach are in this repository.
Live monitor: The page states the date of the data it shows and flags it when that data is stale. Collection runs on free CI, so scheduled slots are best-effort and can be delayed.
Rejections, because they are what make the rest checkable:
features: A predictive bad-debt model whose apparent 3.8x lift was an exposure-time artifact.
A first impairment scan where 19 of 34 flags were false positives from missing price feeds.
